Welcome to 30a Sea-Renity, your perfect 30A escape where relaxation, sunshine, and unforgettable memories come together! Just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands, this stunning five-bedroom, five-bathroom home in beautiful Blue Mountain Beach is designed for gathering, celebrating, and unwinding with family and friends.

This spacious two-story coastal retreat offers an incredible outdoor oasis featuring a private pool, hot tub, outdoor heated shower, fire pit, grilling area, and four beach cruisers ready for exploring the neighborhood. The expansive deck is thoughtfully designed with plenty of loungers and cozy seating areas, giving everyone their own spot to relax after a perfect beach day.

The backyard pool area creates a true vacation vibe with its resort-style atmosphere, while the nearby pergola-covered parking area adds convenience. Out front, a wide welcoming porch spanning the entire home invites you to start your morning with coffee or wind down in the evening breeze.

Whether you’re planning a family beach vacation, reunion, or getaway with friends, Sea-Renity delivers the perfect blend of comfort, fun, and coastal charm.

Pool heating is available October 1 – May 1 for an additional fee

ABOUT THE AREA
Your coastal retreat is nestled in Blue Mountain Beach, one of the most beloved communities along Scenic Highway 30A. This area proudly holds the national “Blue Wave” designation, recognizing the pristine cleanliness of its famous sugar-white sand beaches.

Located between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park, Blue Mountain Beach offers a wonderful mix of natural beauty, local charm, and family-friendly experiences. Spend your days exploring scenic biking and hiking trails, enjoying peaceful beach walks, or discovering the vibrant local dining scene.

Start your mornings with coffee and pastries from the beloved Blue Mountain Bakery, and enjoy relaxed evenings dining at Blue Mabel Restaurant. And of course, no visit is complete without stopping at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery—many locals will tell you it’s the best ice cream on 30A!

Adventure, relaxation, and authentic coastal charm are all waiting just outside your door.

BEACH ACCESS
The closest beach access is Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access, located just a few blocks away at the end of Hwy 83. This access offers restrooms, showers, and parking, making your beach days easy and convenient.

Guests may bring coolers, wagons, single inflatable toys, kayaks, and paddleboards, so pack up your gear and enjoy a perfect day on the Gulf.

ACCOMMODATIONS
Sleeps 15

• Bedroom 1 – Queen (1st Floor)
• Bedroom 2 – Bunk Room with Twin/Full bed
• Bedroom 3 – King, ensuite (2nd Floor) with attached sunroom featuring Twin Daybed & Trundle
• Bedroom 4 – King, ensuite (2nd Floor) with private balcony
• Bedroom 5 – Bunk Room, ensuite with Twin over King and additional futon in loft

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS
• Private backyard pool & hot tub – Pool and/or spa heating available upon request for an additional fee
• 2 Beach Cruisers
• Outdoor grill
• Fire pit with seating
• Outdoor dining area and lounge with hammock
• Large front porch
• Indoor fireplace
• Washer & Dryer
• WiFi and TVs throughout
• Self Check-In
• Coffee makers – drip pot & single serve
• Full linen package: bedding, bath towels, washcloths, and more
• Fully stocked kitchen

PARKING
This home includes 2 parking spaces. No overflow parking is available.

HOUSE RULES
• Check-In: After 4 PM | Check-Out: 10 AM
• No smoking or vaping
• Renters must be 25 years of age or older
• During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may occasionally be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no WiFi, or slow WiFi.
• All rentals require state and county tax plus additional required fees
• Bikes and golf carts are not guaranteed to be at the property or in working order. No refunds will be given due to missing or broken items.

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL
All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement directly with Bonheur Vacations and provide identity verification which includes:
A photo of your government-issued ID (such as a driver’s license)
A selfie for verification

WHY CHOOSE BONHEUR VACATIONS
At Bonheur Vacations, we believe your time at the beach should be effortless, joyful, and truly memorable. Our boutique team is dedicated to creating exceptional vacation experiences along Florida’s Emerald Coast, pairing beautiful homes with thoughtful service.
From the moment you book, our team is here to help you make the most of your stay. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, planning a family reunion, or simply enjoying a well-deserved getaway, we can assist with beach bonfires, private chefs, in-home spa services, yoga sessions, childcare, and more.

Our mission is simple: to turn every stay into a story worth sharing.

We can’t wait to welcome you to 30a Sea-Renity and the beautiful beaches of 30A.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting.
